title: jzx5 follow-up: tunnel_auth_gw_post extracted sender IID with U/L flip (all authentic grants denied WRONG_ROOT)
description: Found by kimi-k3 correctness review of b7z9.93 (pass 1); FIXED in beads-worker-7 same round. lichen/apps/gateway/src/main.c tunnel_auth_gw_post copied the low 8 bytes of the sender link-local and applied lichen_eui64_to_iid() (U/L flip) - but LICHEN wire link-locals embed the canonical U/L-cleared pubkey IID, so the flip corrupted byte 0 and lichen_tunnel_auth_receive's memcmp(sender_iid, ctx->root_iid) could never match: every authentic grant POST to the app-level /.well-known/tunnel-auth resource was denied WRONG_ROOT. Commit 0ee9fc2912 fixed the identical bug in coap_server.c (lichen_tunnel_sender_iid_from_sockaddr, documented at tunnel_auth.h:168-182) but missed this app-level handler. Fix: use lichen_tunnel_sender_iid_from_sockaddr() and fail closed (4.03) on extraction failure. Validated: apps/gateway native_sim build compiles the object (link blocked only by the separate schc symbol-collision bead); host regression test lichen/tests/tunnel_auth/src/main.c test_sender_iid_from_sockaddr pins the correct extraction.
close_reason: Fixed in beads-worker-7 (same round as review): lichen/apps/gateway/src/main.c tunnel_auth_gw_post now uses lichen_tunnel_sender_iid_from_sockaddr() (canonical U/L-cleared pubkey IID) and returns 4.03 on extraction failure instead of the U/L-flipped memcpy+eui64_to_iid pair. Object-level compile verified via apps/gateway native_sim build (link blocked only by the separate schc symbol-collision bead, not this file). Host regression test test_sender_iid_from_sockaddr pins the plane.
